text: In beta (Réglages → Avant-première): invoices and quotes leave from Opusline. « Envoyer par e-mail » on a document opens its send page: the client's address ticked (add another, put yourself in copy), the message from your template and editable for this send, what the client will receive side by side with the document, a test to your own address, and for an invoice whether automatic reminders start once the due date passes. The PDF goes along, and the invoice's history keeps who got it and when.
